title: Which club will Ferran Torres join from Barcelona during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Ferran Torres is a Barcelona forward and Spain international.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official club announcements or confirmed reporting from reputable sports news outlets. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the first club Ferran Torres joins directly from Barcelona during the 2026 summer transfer window. The move must be confirmed as completed; transfer rumors, negotiations, and expressions of interest do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The destination club's name.
